body_en:
FlClash is a free, open-source proxy client built on the Mihomo (Clash Meta) core. It supports Windows, Android, macOS, iOS, and Linux, with a clean interface and a straightforward setup.

Download

  • Windows: FlClash-0.9.3-windows-amd64-setup.exe (installer — download it and double-click to install)
  • Android: FlClash-0.9.3-android-arm64-v8a.apk (installer — download and install; if the system warns you about risks, choose "Install anyway")

How to Use

  1. Open FlClash after installing it.
  2. Import your proxy subscription link (or add nodes manually).
  3. Turn on the proxy, pick a node, and you're online.

That's all there is to it.
